snippet.title: Supremacy: Warhammer 40,000 - Announcement Trailer (Skulls 2025)
snippet.description:
A new war ignites in the grim darkness of the far future.

Supremacy: Warhammer 40,000 brings the legendary strategy franchise to the brutal battlefields of Vigilus.

From the creators of Supremacy 1914, Supremacy: Warhammer 40,000 is a long-term, multiplayer strategy experience set in the iconic Warhammer 40,000 universe—where tactics, domination, war pacts or betrayal decide the fate of the planet.

Go to playsupremacy.com to get updates on Supremacy Warhammer 40,000 and pre-register on Google Play and the App Store now!
